extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking literary representation (including first-time and unsolicited authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for querying WME Books agents and submitting unsolicited manuscripts, including where and how to send query materials, how to pick an agent by genre, and administrative terms to observe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query through agent profile
rubrics_metrics.description: You can query the WME Agent of your choice through their profile page on this website, accessible through the "Our Team" pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the agent's profile to find what each agent represents and their preferred query format. Use the provided query button on the profile to write an email to the correct address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow each agent's preferred query format
rubrics_metrics.description: On each profile, you'll find a bit about what each agent represents, as well as their preferred query format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the specific query format requested by the agent on their profile (the format may vary by agent). Failure to follow an agent's stated preferences may reduce the chance your query is read.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query only one WME agent at a time
rubrics_metrics.description: Please be sure to only query one WME agent at a time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send the same submission to multiple WME agents simultaneously. If you haven't heard back in six weeks, you may then try another agent within the department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wait six weeks before querying another agent
rubrics_metrics.description: If you haven’t heard back in six weeks, you can feel free to try another agent in the department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow a six-week response window before querying a different WME agent to avoid multiple simultaneous submissions within the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agree to and read Submission Terms & Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: By sending your materials to our agents, you’re agreeing to our Submission Terms & Conditions, so be sure to read them before you hit send.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the Submission Terms & Conditions linked on the site prior to submitting; sending materials constitutes agreement to those terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: WME accepts unsolicited manuscripts and welcomes first-time authors
rubrics_metrics.description: We spend a lot of time reviewing unsolicited manuscripts and love championing first-time authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unsolicited submissions are actively reviewed, and first-time authors are welcomed; this is an invitation to submit but does not replace following stated profile/format requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose an agent by genre / use Team pages to match genre
rubrics_metrics.description: WME’s books division represents authors in all genres (commercial, upmarket, literary fiction, non-fiction, children's, graphic novels, etc.) and provides Team pages (UK Team, US Team) and genre listings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Team and genre lists to identify an agent who represents your book’s category (e.g., thriller, memoir, YA, science fiction, narrative nonfiction). Query the agent who lists your genre and specialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult full Submission Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides a 'View Submission Guidelines' link for more detailed submission instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the full Submission Guidelines page for any additional requirements (manuscript length, materials to include, file formats, attachments, etc.) not reproduced on this overview page.
